101:If the restore fails, pi-action resets the checkout and removes the untracked files of the restore, and pi starts from the clean checkout. A failed restore does not make the run fail. If the checkout has uncommitted changes or untracked files (that git does not ignore) before the restore, pi-action does not restore the snapshot.
